list.title: Referral requests
list.roleNote: Post the goods, services, property, equipment or startup space you need, and referrers will find it for you!
list.warn: Posts here reveal other companies' internal situations. “We want to offload stock” or “We need equipment” becomes a bargaining chip if competitors or business partners see it. That's why each request has a visibility setting, and a private option that hides the company name and shows only the industry and size.

list.autoClose: Requests close automatically 30 days after posting. If filled requests aren't closed, the list fills up with stale posts.

detail.proposeLead: Connect a supplier you know. The chat opens only when the requester accepts, and the referral is credited at that moment.
detail.feeLabel: Expected referral fee if the deal closes
detail.feeNote:
This is the amount the requester hopes to pay — it is not calculated from a rate table (A-12). The final amount is agreed in the chat after acceptance.

The supplier pays it — the requesting company pays nothing.
detail.attribution:
The referral is credited when an offer is accepted, not when it is made.

With “Refer”, the referral is credited for 90 days to the first person whose code is used (INV-2). If referral requests used the same rule, someone could lock a request for 90 days just by making an offer first and doing nothing. So here, the credit goes to the offer the requester accepts.
detail.acceptedSteps:
① A 1:1 chat opens and a deal is created

② A referral code is issued — at this point both sides' subscriptions are checked (INV-8)

③ The rest of the flow is the same as “Refer” — contract · deal confirmation · settlement
